name: Spot Bitcoin ETF — Buy the Rumor, Sell the News (Jan 2024)
description: After a months-long run-up on approval hopes, the SEC clears 11 spot Bitcoin ETFs on January 10, 2024 and they begin trading the next day. Bitcoin tags ~$49k on the news — then sells off hard as Grayscale's GBTC bleeds billions in outflows, bottoming near $38.5k by January 23 before grinding back above $50k in February. A textbook 'buy the rumor, sell the news' round trip: tests whether a bot chases the event or fades the euphoria, and how it handles a sharp post-catalyst reversal.
